mapper.sql: t.*, u.nickname AS assignee_name, pt.name AS predecessor_name, CASE WHEN t.status <> 'DONE' AND t.plan_end < #{today} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS overdue
mapper.select: SELECT FROM pm_task t LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = t.assignee_id LEFT JOIN pm_task pt ON pt.id = t.predecessor_id WHERE t.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY t.sort, t.plan_start, t.id

SELECT , p.name AS project_name FROM pm_task t JOIN pm_project p ON p.id = t.project_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = t.assignee_id LEFT JOIN pm_task pt ON pt.id = t.predecessor_id WHERE t.assignee_id = #{userId} AND t.status <> 'DONE' AND p.status IN ('PLANNING', 'APPROVING', 'ACTIVE') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pm_task s WHERE s.parent_id = t.id) ORDER BY t.plan_end

SELECT t.assignee_id AS "userId", SUM(t.plan_hours * (100 - t.progress) / 100) AS "hours" FROM pm_task t JOIN pm_project p ON p.id = t.project_id WHERE t.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND t.status <> 'DONE' AND p.status IN ('PLANNING', 'APPROVING', 'ACTIVE') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pm_task s WHERE s.parent_id = t.id) GROUP BY t.assignee_id
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(hours), 0) FROM pm_timesheet WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'APPROVED'
